libraries.name: SQLite

libraries.name: ring

libraries.name: AWS-LC
libraries.license: ISC AND (Apache-2.0 OR ISC) AND Apache-2.0 AND MIT AND BSD-3-Clause AND (Apache-2.0 OR ISC OR MIT) AND (Apache-2.0 OR ISC OR MIT-0)
libraries.note: AWS-LC's bundled C and assembly, compiled by the crate's build script with its cc builder (no CMake); on Windows x64 the bundled `prebuilt-nasm` objects. `fin-registry` uses it through `aws-lc-rs` for TUF signatures and the editor's ed25519 keys (8A Decision 8)
